intro: Swoop Hunting is a rite of tracking and marksmanship offered by Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village. To prove their cleverness and patience, hunters and travelers are challenged to stalk the elusive birds across the rolling plains of Mulgore. Returning with their pristine trophy quills demonstrates both dedication to the hunt and respect for the natural trials of the Earth Mother.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt. A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.
If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.
Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.
The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the swoops, friend. Do you have their quills?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, friend. In doing this, you prove that you are an adventurer of merit. It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
